class="col"><div class="docItemContainer_joH8"><article><div class="theme-doc-markdown markdown"><header><h1>Announcements</h1></header><div class="row"><div class="col col--12 markdown">
<div class="upx-full-bleed"></div>
<p>New API launches, breaking changes, and deprecation notices for the Upstox Developer API — newest first.</p>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">July 7, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/plugin-marketplace-launch">Upstox Plugin Marketplace for Claude</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>The Upstox MCP server and Agent Skill are now installable from a single Claude plugin marketplace — run <code>/plugin marketplace add upstox/upstox-plugin-marketplace</code>, then install <code>upstox-mcp</code> (read-only account access) or <code>upstox-skill</code> (trading workflows). Now supported in Claude Code and the Claude Desktop and web app, with no config file or Node.js for the plugin path.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/plugin-marketplace-launch">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">June 6, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/analytics-token-static-ip">Analytics Token now Supports Portfolio & Trade APIs via Static IP</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>The Analytics Token — a single read-only token with 1-year validity — now unlocks account-specific APIs via Static IP, so you can analyze your portfolio, positions, holdings, orders, and profit & loss without daily re-authorization.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/analytics-token-static-ip">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">June 6, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/payout-management-apis">Payout Management APIs</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>New Payout Management APIs are available to initiate, modify, and cancel fund withdrawals via NEFT or IMPS, and check payout mode eligibility for your account.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/payout-management-apis">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">June 6, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/agent-skills-launch">Upstox Agent Skills Launch</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>The Upstox Agent Skill is now available — install it in Claude Code, Codex, or any SKILL.md-compatible agent to place orders, stream market data, and manage your portfolio across NSE, BSE, and MCX, built on the official upstox-python-sdk.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/agent-skills-launch">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">May 29, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/smartlist-apis">Smartlist APIs Launch</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>Three new Smartlist APIs are now available — Get Futures Smartlist, Get Options Smartlist, and Get MTF Smartlist — delivering curated, real-time ranked lists of F&O contracts and MTF-eligible stocks.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/smartlist-apis">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">May 23, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/ipo-api">IPO API Launch</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>IPO APIs are now available — fetch a paginated list of IPOs by status and issue type, and retrieve detailed per-IPO data including price band, lot size, timeline, registrar info, and subscription figures.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/ipo-api">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">May 11, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/global-instruments">Global Instruments Support</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>A new Global Instruments file is now available, providing instrument keys for major global indices and indicators — GIFT NIFTY, Dow Jones, S&P, FTSE 100, and more — for use with market quote and historical candle data APIs.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/global-instruments">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">May 11, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/analytics-apis">New Market Information APIs Launch</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>Six new Market Information APIs are now available — FII activity, DII activity, Open Interest, Change in OI, Max Pain, and Put-Call Ratio — providing institutional-grade market data for F&O analysis and trading tools.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/analytics-apis">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">May 11, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/company-fundamentals-api">Company Fundamentals API Launch</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>New Company Fundamentals APIs are available to retrieve financial statements, key ratios, shareholding patterns, corporate actions, and competitor data for any listed company by ISIN. The suite includes 8 endpoints: Company Profile, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, Income Statement, Share Holdings, Key Ratios, Corporate Actions, and Competitors.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/company-fundamentals-api">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">May 4, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/payments-api">Payments API Launch</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>New Payments APIs are available to retrieve the pay-in and payout transactions, including amount, mode, status, bank name, and charge details.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/payments-api">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">April 24, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/mutual-fund-apis">Mutual Funds API Launch</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>New Mutual Fund APIs are available to retrieve the order book, order details, SIPs, and holdings.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/mutual-fund-apis">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">April 17, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/webhook-url-security-policy">Webhook URL Security Policy</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>All webhook URLs registered on the Upstox Developer Platform are validated against a security filter before an app can be created, protecting user accounts from dynamic DNS, phishing, malware, spam, and proxy bypass threats.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/webhook-url-security-policy">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">April 17, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/news-api">News API Launch</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>Introducing the News API — fetch news articles for specific instrument keys, your current positions, or your holdings portfolio with pagination support.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/news-api">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">April 10, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/get-funds-and-margin-v3">Get Fund and Margin V3 API</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>We have released the new Get Fund and Margin V3 API, offering a detailed balance breakdown including cash available, pledged margin, and unsettled profit components — without requiring a segment parameter.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/get-funds-and-margin-v3">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">April 10, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/kill-switch-api">Kill Switch API Launch</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>Introducing the Kill Switch API — two new endpoints to programmatically enable or disable specific trading segments, helping traders avoid impulsive decisions by temporarily halting activity in one or more segments.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/kill-switch-api">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">April 10, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/static-ip-apis">Static IP Management APIs</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>Two new endpoints — GET and PUT <code>/user/ip</code> — are now available for reading and updating user-level static IP addresses required for algo trading compliance.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/static-ip-apis">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT"></div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/algo-trading-circular">Important Updates – Algo Registration & Static IP Requirement</a><span class="tag__yJh tagImportant_jpfi">Important</span></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>The Exchange has issued a significant circular dated <a href="https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/INVG67858.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="">May 5, 2025</a>, to enhance the safety of retail investors participating in Algo trading.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/algo-trading-circular">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">March 20, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/analytics-token">Analytics Token</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>Introducing the Analytics Token — a long-lived, read-only access token with 1-year validity for programmatic access to market data, holdings, positions, and historical records without the standard OAuth flow.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/analytics-token">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">March 17, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/instrument-search-api">Search API for Instruments</a><span class="tag__yJh tagBeta_uhvv">Beta</span></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>Search for instruments by query and apply filters like exchanges, segments, instrument types, expiry, or ATM offset.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/instrument-search-api">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">March 11, 2026</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/market-protection">Market Protection for Market and Stoploss Market Orders</a><span class="tag__yJh tagBeta_uhvv">Beta</span></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>Optional <code>market_protection</code> parameter is now available when placing or modifying Market or Stoploss Market orders.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/market-protection">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">December 6, 2025</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/nse-pre-open-session">NSE's Pre-Open Session for Futures LIVE from 8 December</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>NSE's pre-open session for futures is now live from December 8, 2025. This session allows traders to place and modify orders before the regular trading hours begin, providing an opportunity to react to overnight news and market developments.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/nse-pre-open-session">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">August 22, 2025</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/v2-websocket-discontinued">V2 Websocket Discontinued</a><span class="tag__yJh tagDiscontinued_BVfy">Discontinued</span></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>The Market Data Feeder V2 Websocket service will become discontinued on August 22, 2025, and will be completely stopped after this date. All users should migrate to the V3 Websocket service to avoid any disruption in market data streaming.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/v2-websocket-discontinued">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">July 19, 2025</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/fund-margin-api-change">Fund and Margin API Response Change</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>Starting July 19, 2025, the <a class="" href="/developer/api-documentation/get-user-fund-margin">Fund and Margin API</a> will return combined funds for both Equity and Commodity segments in the <code>equity</code> object. This change affects applications that process segment specific fund data separately.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/fund-margin-api-change">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">Jun 30, 2025</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/tsl-gtt-order">Launch of Trailing Stop Loss order</a><span class="tag__yJh tagBeta_uhvv">Beta</span></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>We've introduced Trailing Stop Loss functionality to our GTT Order API, allowing your stop-loss orders to automatically adjust as the market moves in your favor, providing dynamic risk management.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/tsl-gtt-order">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">June 30, 2025</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/deprecation-notice-v2">Deprecation of several V2 APIs</a><span class="tag__yJh tagDeprecated_Zt1x">Deprecated</span></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>We are deprecating several v2 APIs to streamline our offerings and encourage users to migrate to the corresponding v3 endpoints.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/deprecation-notice-v2">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">Jun 20, 2025</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/gtt-mtf-support">Support for MTF in GTT Order</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>We have enabled support for the Margin Trading Facility (MTF) product within the GTT order placement API. This enables the placement of GTT orders with margin funding directly through the API.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/gtt-mtf-support">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">May 13, 2025</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/expired-instruments-api">Expired Instruments APIs Launch</a><span class="tag__yJh tagPlus_xVRO">Upstox Plus</span></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>We are rolling out new Expired Instruments APIs under the Upstox Plus plan. This suite of APIs provides access to historical data for expired instruments, offering the following features:</p><ul>
<li class="">Get Expiries.</li>
<li class="">Get Expired Option Contracts.</li>
<li class="">Get Expired Future Contracts.</li>
<li class="">Get Expired Historical Candle Data.</li>
</ul></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/expired-instruments-api">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">May 13, 2025</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/websocket-plus">Websocket Plus Features</a><span class="tag__yJh tagPlus_xVRO">Upstox Plus</span></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>We are rolling out new websocket features under the Upstox Plus plan, enhancing our v3 websocket with:</p><ul>
<li class="">Increased concurrent connections (up to 5 per user).</li>
<li class="">Full D30 subscription mode supporting up to 50 instruments per connection.</li>
</ul></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/websocket-plus">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">Apr 17, 2025</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/enhanced-historical-candle-data-apis-v3">Enhanced Historical Candle Data APIs - V3 Launch</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>We're excited to introduce enhanced V3 versions of both standard <a class="" href="/developer/api-documentation/get-intra-day-candle-data">Intraday</a> and <a class="" href="/developer/api-documentation/get-historical-candle-data">Historical</a> Candle Data APIs with expanded intervals and improved flexibility. These APIs support customizable time units from <code>minutes</code> to <code>months</code> with flexible intervals, offering more granular control for technical analysis.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/enhanced-historical-candle-data-apis-v3">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">Apr 17, 2025</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/market-quote-v3">Market Quote V3 API</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>We have released the new Market Quote V3 APIs, which include additional features and enhancements based on user feedback.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/market-quote-v3">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">Apr 17, 2025</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/mis-file">Margin Intraday Square-off (MIS) File Now Available</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>We have provided <strong>Margin Intraday Square-off (MIS) file</strong>, which you can now download directly from the <a class="" href="/developer/api-documentation/instruments#mis-instruments">Instruments Section</a> of our Developer Documentation.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/mis-file">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">Apr 4, 2025</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/mtf-support">Support for MTF Order</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>We have enabled the support for Margin Trading Facility (MTF) product in the order placement API. This enables placing orders with margin funding directly through the API.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/mtf-support">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">Feb 28, 2025</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/new-gtt-order-api">Introduction of GTT Order API</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>A new GTT Order API has been introduced, allowing users to create, modify, and cancel Good Till Trigger (GTT) orders seamlessly.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/new-gtt-order-api">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">Feb 12, 2025</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/pop-field-addition">Minor Update to Put/Call Option Chain API</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>A new field <strong>pop</strong> has been added to the <strong>option_greeks</strong> object of the Put/Call Option Chain API response.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/pop-field-addition">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">Jan 16, 2025</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/access-token-flow">Beta Launch of Access Token Flow for User</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>Beta release of an access token flow for an individual users. This feature empowers Initiators to effortlessly generate access tokens for their customers, ensuring a seamless and efficient trading experience.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/access-token-flow">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">Jan 16, 2025</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/sandbox-mode-for-apis">Sandbox Mode for API Integration</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>We are bringing convenience to your API integration. Introducing sandbox mode to test integrations safely before going live.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/sandbox-mode-for-apis">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">Jan 3, 2025</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/new-market-feeder-v3">Market Data Feeder V3 Launch & V2 Deprecation</a><span class="tag__yJh tagImportant_jpfi">Important</span></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>The Market Data Feeder V3 has been launched, offering improved stability and deeper insights. <strong>Feeder V2 will be deprecated by March 2, 2025</strong>, with only the V3 version available starting March 3, 2025.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/new-market-feeder-v3">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">Nov 11, 2024</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/beta-launch-of-v3-order">Beta Launch of Order API V3</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>We are excited to announce the beta release of enhanced version of Order API V3 to support the order slicing and latency information tracking.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/beta-launch-of-v3-order">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">Oct 8, 2024</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/beta-launch-of-multi-apis">Beta Launch of Highly Requested APIs</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>We are excited to announce the beta release of three highly requested APIs: Place Multi Order, Cancel All Open Orders, and Exit All Positions.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/beta-launch-of-multi-apis">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">Sep 10, 2024</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/market-proto-changes-notice">Deprecation of Fields in Market Data Feed</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>Several fields in the market data feed will be discontinued on <strong>Oct 10, 2024</strong>.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/market-proto-changes-notice">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">Aug 30, 2024</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/update-zero-brokerage">Update on ZERO brokerage via Upstox API</a><span class="tag__yJh tagDiscontinued_BVfy">Discontinued</span></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>Starting 31 August 2024, we will no longer offer zero-brokerage API trades. However, new Upstox API users from 1 September 2024 will be eligible for 90 days of zero brokerage.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/update-zero-brokerage">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">Jul 26, 2024</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/enhanced-url">Faster order execution via API</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>Order execution over APIs is now significantly faster. Use the new endpoint for place, modify, and cancel operations to take advantage of this improvement.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/enhanced-url">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">Apr 25, 2024</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/instruments-csv-deprecation-notice">CSV Instruments File Deprecation Notice</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>The <a class="" href="/developer/api-documentation/instruments#csv-files">CSV format</a> for the instruments file will soon be deprecated. We recommend users to transition to the <a class="" href="/developer/api-documentation/instruments#json-files">JSON version</a> for improved functionality and support.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/instruments-csv-deprecation-notice">Read more →</a></div></article>
<article class="entry_jkKM"><div class="date_hyJT">Mar 7, 2024</div><div><h2 class="title_ttne"><a class="upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/new-url-and-simplified-headers">New URL and Simplified Headers</a></h2><div class="summary_MltS"><p>Upstox API now accessible at a new URL <code>https://api.upstox.com/v2</code> with simplified header requirements. Old and new URLs operational during transition. Migration advised.</p></div><a class="readMore_IPi9 upx-card-link" href="/developer/api-documentation/announcements/new-url-and-simplified-headers">Read more
